quests.title: Pocket monster
quests.description: Doodle a tiny creature that lives in your pocket. Give it a name too!

twists.text: Draw it with your eyes closed.
Only circles and triangles allowed.

id.title: Monster saku
id.description: Gambar makhluk kecil yang tinggal di saku kamu. Kasih nama juga ya!

twists.shapes-only: Cuma boleh pakai bulat sama segitiga.

quests.title: Your day in 3 words
quests.description: Sum up your day so far in just three words.

twists.text: All three words start with the same letter.

id.title: Hari ini dalam 3 kata
id.description: Ceritain hari kamu sejauh ini cuma pakai tiga kata.

twists.same-letter: Ketiga katanya diawali huruf yang sama.

quests.title: Promote an object
quests.description: Pick something on your desk and turn it into a superhero.

twists.text: Its weakness is something totally normal, like Mondays.

id.title: Barang jadi superhero
id.description: Pilih satu barang di meja kamu, terus jadiin superhero.

twists.boring-weakness: Kelemahannya harus hal receh, kayak hari Senin.

quests.title: Mood forecast
quests.description: Draw your mood right now as a weather forecast. Sunny? Cloudy? Stormy?

id.title: Ramalan cuaca mood
id.description: Gambar mood kamu sekarang sebagai ramalan cuaca. Cerah? Mendung? Badai?

quests.title: Fancy paint names
quests.description: Spot 3 colors near you and name them like expensive paint shades.

twists.text: Every name must be food-themed.

id.title: Nama warna sok mewah
id.description: Cari 3 warna di sekitar kamu, terus kasih nama ala cat tembok mahal.

quests.title: One-line portrait
quests.description: Draw a face in one single line, without letting go.

twists.text: A magnificent mustache is mandatory.

id.title: Wajah satu garis
id.description: Gambar wajah dalam satu garis aja, tanpa diangkat.

quests.title: Invent a holiday
quests.description: Make up a brand-new holiday. What is it called?

twists.text: It celebrates a vegetable.

id.title: Libur versi kamu
id.description: Bikin hari libur baru. Namanya apa?

twists.vegetable: Hari liburnya buat ngerayain satu sayuran.

quests.title: Treasure map
quests.description: Draw a mini treasure map of your room. Don't forget the X!

twists.text: Add a dragon guarding something boring.

id.title: Peta harta karun
id.description: Gambar peta harta karun kamar kamu. Jangan lupa tanda X-nya!

twists.dragon: Tambahin naga yang jagain barang nggak penting.

quests.title: Lunch remix
quests.description: Rename your favorite song so it is about your last meal.

twists.text: Hum the first line with the new title.

id.title: Remix judul lagu
id.description: Ganti judul lagu favorit kamu jadi tentang makanan terakhir yang kamu makan.

twists.hum-it: Senandungin baris pertamanya pakai judul baru.

quests.title: Square breathing
quests.description: Breathe in 4, hold 4, out 4, hold 4. Just follow Boo.

id.title: Napas kotak
id.description: Tarik napas 4 detik, tahan 4, buang 4, tahan 4. Ikutin Boo aja.

quests.title: 5-4-3-2-1 scan
quests.description: Slowly notice your surroundings and tick them off one by one.

id.title: Scan 5-4-3-2-1
id.description: Pelan-pelan, sadari sekitar kamu dan centang satu per satu.

quests.title: Shoulder melt
quests.description: Lift your shoulders to your ears, hold for 3 seconds, then drop. Tap each time.

id.title: Lemesin bahu
id.description: Angkat bahu sampai kuping, tahan 3 detik, terus lepas. Tap tiap kali, ya.

quests.title: Potion of hydration
quests.description: Get a glass of water and sip it slowly, like a rare and fancy potion.

twists.text: Review it like a food vlogger.

id.title: Ramuan hidrasi
id.description: Ambil segelas air, terus minum pelan-pelan kayak ramuan langka.

quests.title: Eye vacation
quests.description: Look at something far away until the timer ends. Your eyes need a break from screens.

id.title: Liburan mata
id.description: Lihat sesuatu yang jauh sampai timernya habis. Mata kamu butuh rehat dari layar.

quests.title: Slow-mo mode
quests.description: Do your next small move, like picking up a cup, in super slow motion.

twists.text: Add slow-motion sound effects.

id.title: Mode slow-mo
id.description: Lakuin gerakan kecil berikutnya, misalnya ambil gelas, super pelan kayak di film.

quests.title: Tiny tidy
quests.description: Put exactly three things back where they belong. Only three, then stop!

id.title: Beres-beres mini
id.description: Balikin tiga barang ke tempatnya. Tiga aja, terus udahan!

quests.title: Starfish stretch
quests.description: Stand up and stretch as wide as a starfish until the timer ends.

twists.text: Add the biggest yawn you can.

id.title: Peregangan bintang laut
id.description: Berdiri dan rentangin badan selebar bintang laut sampai timernya habis.

quests.title: Glad it exists
quests.description: Name one small thing you are glad exists today. Socks without holes count.

id.title: Bersyukur receh
id.description: Sebutin satu hal kecil yang bikin kamu bersyukur hari ini. Kaus kaki nggak bolong juga boleh.

quests.title: Real compliment
quests.description: Compliment someone on something they chose, like their playlist or their idea.

id.title: Pujian tulus
id.description: Puji seseorang soal pilihannya, misalnya playlist atau idenya.

quests.title: Send a smile
quests.description: Send a friend something that will make them smile. No reason needed.

twists.text: Emojis only.

id.title: Kirim senyum
id.description: Kirim sesuatu ke teman yang bikin dia senyum. Nggak perlu alasan.

quests.title: The ant question
quests.description: Ask someone: if you could shrink to ant size for a day, what would you do?

id.title: Pertanyaan semut
id.description: Tanya ke seseorang: kalau bisa jadi sekecil semut seharian, mau ngapain?

quests.title: High-five hunt
quests.description: Get a high-five from someone. Virtual high-fives totally count.

id.title: Tos dulu
id.description: Minta tos ke seseorang. Tos virtual juga sah kok.

quests.title: Share a gem
quests.description: Recommend a song, show or game you love to someone, with one sentence why.

id.title: Bagi rekomendasi
id.description: Rekomenin lagu, film, atau game favorit ke seseorang, plus satu kalimat alasannya.

quests.title: Tiny thank-you
quests.description: Thank someone for something small they did recently. Small is the point.

id.title: Makasih kecil
id.description: Bilang makasih ke seseorang buat hal kecil yang dia lakuin baru-baru ini.

quests.title: Two truths, one lie
quests.description: Play one round of two truths and a lie with someone.

id.title: Dua jujur satu bohong
id.description: Main satu ronde dua jujur satu bohong bareng seseorang.

quests.title: Old friend ping
quests.description: Say hi to someone you have not talked to in a while.

id.title: Sapa teman lama
id.description: Sapa seseorang yang udah lama nggak kamu ajak ngobrol.

quests.title: Cloud detective
quests.description: Find a cloud, stain or pattern that looks like an animal. What is it?

id.title: Detektif awan
id.description: Cari awan, noda, atau pola yang mirip hewan. Mirip apa?

quests.title: Sound safari
quests.description: Close your eyes for 30 seconds. Tap once for every different sound you hear.

id.title: Safari suara
id.description: Merem 30 detik. Tap sekali tiap kamu denger suara yang beda.

quests.title: Alphabet hunt
quests.description: Find something nearby for every letter from A to E.

id.title: Berburu abjad
id.description: Cari barang di sekitar kamu buat tiap huruf dari A sampai E.

quests.title: Texture hunt
quests.description: Find the softest, roughest and smoothest things within arm's reach.

id.title: Berburu tekstur
id.description: Cari barang paling lembut, paling kasar, dan paling licin dalam jangkauan tangan.

quests.title: New angle
quests.description: Look at your room from a spot where you never stand or sit. What looks different?

twists.text: Lie on the floor and look up.

id.title: Sudut baru
id.description: Lihat kamar kamu dari tempat yang nggak pernah kamu dudukin. Apa yang beda?

twists.floor: Rebahan di lantai terus lihat ke atas.

quests.title: Macro world
quests.description: Take a super close-up photo of something ordinary until it looks like an alien planet.

id.title: Dunia makro
id.description: Foto close-up barang biasa sampai kelihatan kayak planet alien.

quests.title: Color quest
quests.description: Pick a color, then tap every time you spot something in it. Aim for 5!

twists.text: Use the color of the last thing you ate.

id.title: Misi warna
id.description: Pilih satu warna, terus tap tiap nemu barang warna itu. Targetnya 5!

twists.last-snack: Pakai warna makanan terakhir yang kamu makan.

quests.title: Secret job
quests.description: Look outside and give the first person, animal or car you see a secret job.

id.title: Kerjaan rahasia
id.description: Lihat ke luar, terus kasih kerjaan rahasia buat orang, hewan, atau mobil pertama yang kamu lihat.

quests.title: Time traveler
quests.description: Find the oldest thing near you. How old do you think it is?

id.title: Penjelajah waktu
id.description: Cari barang paling tua di dekat kamu. Kira-kira umurnya berapa?

quests.title: Paper three-pointer
quests.description: Crumple some paper and shoot it into a bin from three steps away. Tap for every hit!

twists.text: Shoot with your other hand.

id.title: Three-point kertas
id.description: Remas kertas, lempar ke tempat sampah dari tiga langkah. Tap tiap masuk!

quests.title: Stack attack
quests.description: Stack 5 random things into the tallest tower you can.

twists.text: Include at least two round things.

id.title: Menara barang
id.description: Susun 5 barang random jadi menara setinggi mungkin.

quests.title: Staring contest
quests.description: Have a staring contest with a mirror, a pet or a friend.

id.title: Lomba nggak kedip
id.description: Lomba nggak kedip sama cermin, hewan peliharaan, atau teman.

quests.title: Desk drummer
quests.description: Drum a beat on your desk until the timer ends, then try to repeat it.

id.title: Drummer meja
id.description: Main drum di meja sampai timernya habis, terus coba ulang ketukan yang sama.

quests.title: Best of five
quests.description: Play rock-paper-scissors, best of five. No opponent? Left hand versus right hand.

id.title: Suit best of five
id.description: Main suit, best of five. Nggak ada lawan? Tangan kiri lawan tangan kanan.

quests.title: Flamingo mode
quests.description: Stand on one foot until the timer ends. Brave enough to close your eyes?

id.title: Mode flamingo
id.description: Berdiri satu kaki sampai timernya habis. Berani sambil merem?

quests.title: Word chain
quests.description: Write a word, then a word starting with its last letter. Keep the chain going!

twists.text: Animals only.
Food only.

id.title: Sambung kata
id.description: Tulis satu kata, terus kata berikutnya mulai dari huruf terakhirnya. Sambung terus!

quests.title: Pen flip
quests.description: Flip a pen so it lands standing up. Tap for every try, ten tries max.

id.title: Flip pulpen
id.description: Lempar pulpen biar mendarat berdiri. Tap tiap percobaan, maksimal sepuluh.

quests.title: Name that hum
quests.description: Hum a song and see if someone can guess it. Solo? Guess the next line yourself.

id.title: Tebak senandung
id.description: Senandungin lagu, suruh seseorang nebak. Lagi sendiri? Tebak sendiri lirik selanjutnya.

quests.title: Nature documentary
quests.description: Narrate what you are doing like a whispering wildlife documentary host.

id.title: Narator dokumenter
id.description: Ceritain apa yang lagi kamu lakuin, kayak narator film dokumenter hewan.

quests.title: Secret handshake
quests.description: Invent a secret handshake with at least four moves. Teach it to someone, or your cat.

id.title: Salam rahasia
id.description: Bikin salam rahasia minimal empat gerakan. Ajarin ke seseorang, atau ke kucing kamu.

quests.title: Confident nonsense
quests.description: Make up a fake fact about something near you, then say it with total confidence.

id.title: Fakta ngarang
id.description: Bikin fakta palsu soal barang di dekat kamu, terus ucapin dengan pede banget.

quests.title: Villain laugh
quests.description: Practice your best evil-villain laugh. Three attempts. Commit fully!

id.title: Tawa penjahat
id.description: Latihan ketawa ala penjahat film. Tiga kali. Totalitas ya!

quests.title: Thank an object
quests.description: Thank something you use every day, out loud. It has been working hard.

id.title: Makasih, barang
id.description: Bilang makasih ke barang yang kamu pakai tiap hari. Dia udah kerja keras.

quests.title: Runway walk
quests.description: Walk to the next room like it is a fashion runway.

twists.text: Do it as a robot.
Do it as a penguin.

id.title: Jalan ala runway
id.description: Jalan ke ruangan sebelah kayak lagi di catwalk.

quests.title: Ten-second dance party
quests.description: Dance like nobody is watching until the timer ends. Chair dancing counts.

twists.text: Only your eyebrows are allowed to dance.

id.title: Joget sepuluh detik
id.description: Joget bebas sampai timernya habis. Joget sambil duduk juga boleh.

quests.title: Ghost roommate
quests.description: A friendly ghost lives in your room. What is its name, and what does it complain about?

id.title: Hantu sekamar
id.description: Ada hantu ramah tinggal di kamar kamu. Siapa namanya, dan dia suka ngeluh soal apa?

quests.title: Backwards name
quests.description: Write your full name backwards, then try to read it out loud.

id.title: Nama kebalik
id.description: Tulis nama lengkap kamu dari belakang, terus coba baca keras-keras.

quests.title: Note to future you
quests.description: Write one sentence to yourself a year from now. It stays in your Journal.

id.title: Pesan buat kamu tahun depan
id.description: Tulis satu kalimat buat diri kamu setahun lagi. Nanti tersimpan di Jurnal.
